sources.use: Distinguishes minimum-curvature geometric lines from minimum-time lines requiring vehicle dynamics; no code copied.
Smooth spline representation and conservative constraints when dynamics are unavailable; not implementation or certification of that paper.

limitations: No tire, aero, powertrain, speed/braking optimization, real telemetry or Assetto Corsa AI validation.
Kerb shape is a fictional low-profile racing design, not an FIA-approved drawing.
Route widths, hairpin conversion, elevations, mapped buildings and pit position inherited unchanged.
Centre clearance is exact for dense piecewise-linear line; C2 spline sampled at <=0.5m and 5x2m rectangles tested at those samples, not a formal continuous swept-volume proof.
Barrier/guardrail meshes are not part of this 2D calculation; native-scene clearance and driver-view inspection remain required.
height_contract: samples.z is a v08 reference only; native heights after v11 DSM are in racing_line_native_v15.json samples.z_native_m, written by apply().
